raw_segments.text: Fluorizal, so call it, but it does fulfill my vow.
I needs must think it honesty.
Camillo, not for Bohemia, nor the pomp that may be there at Gleaned, for all the sun seas
or the close earth wombs, or the profound seas hides in unknown fathoms, will I break
my oath to this my fair beloved.
Therefore, I pray you, as you have ever been my father's honored friend, when he shall
miss me, as in faith I mean not to see him anymore, cast your good counsels upon his
passion, let myself and fortune tug for the time to come.
This you may know, and so deliver, I am put to see with her whom here I cannot hold on
shore, and most opportune to her need, I have a vessel rides fast by, but not prepared for
